The bank funds 80% of your asset and gets zero equity upside.
That’s the deal leveraged investors have been using for decades.
You bring 20%. They bring 80%. The asset appreciates you keep 100% of the gain above their fixed interest cost. They get repaid in future dollars worth less than today. Inflation erodes their real return while your asset reprices upward.
Fixed debt. Floating asset. Frozen liability. Moving equity.
The investor who borrowed at 3% locked in a structural advantage that cannot be undone. Every payment made in cheaper future dollars. Every appreciation point captured in full.
This is not speculation. This is how institutions, private equity firms, and generational wealth builders have always operated.
The game was never about how much you own.
It was always about how much you control.
